## 13. CHANGES TO THESE TERMS  
### 13.1 Our Right to Change Terms  
We can change these terms if:
- We give 30 days written notice
- Change is in our or your legitimate interest
- Change reflects regulatory changes

raw_entities.description: The bank reserves the right to modify account terms with 30 days written notice to the customer. Changes may be made when in the legitimate interest of either party or to reflect regulatory requirements.

raw_entities.description: The bank may modify terms when such changes serve the legitimate interests of the bank or the customer, providing a contractual basis for discretionary term amendments beyond regulatory requirements.
context: Change is in our or your legitimate interest

raw_entities.description: The bank may modify terms to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, ensuring the product remains compliant with applicable banking and financial services regulations.
